headline_seed: Thousands of people under evacuation order from wildfires in Spokane, Wash. - NPR
draft_text:
#BreakingMews A fast-moving wildfire near Spokane forced thousands of residents under Level 3 evacuation orders Saturday. Gov. Bob Ferguson declared a statewide emergency. NPR and CNN report 4,000-5,000 structures threatened.

And that's the mews.
